principle_violations.reason: The 'PaymentProcessor' class handles both payment processing and directly modifies the order status, conflating multiple responsibilities.
principle_violations.suggestion: Decouple the order status update logic from the 'PaymentProcessor' class. Introduce a separate 'OrderStatusManager' or pass responsibility back to the 'Order' class for better encapsulation.

principle_violations.reason: The 'PaymentProcessor' class does not easily extend to support different payment mechanisms without modification.
principle_violations.suggestion: Introduce an interface or abstract class for payment processors so new payment methods can be added without modifying the existing code.

overall_feedback: 2 principle violations found. Please see the details above.
